failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of carbon tetrachloride exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 30°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: BPR set below required 3.93 bar, leading to insufficient back pressure
failure_modes.mitigation: Regularly calibrate and test BPR to ensure it maintains at least 3.93 bar

failure_modes.cause: Inadequate photon penetration due to fouling or misalignment
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement regular cleaning and alignment checks of the photochemical reactor

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.5 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR valve at various settings to ensure it maintains at least 3.93 bar
Conduct photon penetration tests with a calibrated light source to ensure adequate delivery
